brief:
Bank of Palestine has launched a "Back to School" initiative under the slogan "A New Year and New Hope" to support students in the early grades of Gaza's schools, the Ma'an news agency reported.

The program aims to assist primary-level pupils amid ongoing challenges in the territory. The initiative reflects the bank's commitment to educational support during a critical period for young learners in the Gaza Strip.
title: Bank of Palestine launches back-to-school initiative for Gaza's early grades
